title: School district administration
goal: Show board governance and district school leadership.

rubric.must: The Board of Education visibly sits above and connects to the superintendent.
Oak, Maple, Valley Middle, and Valley High principals visibly sit under their relevant school executive.
Teaching and Learning visibly leads Mathematics and Student Services.
The superintendent is the only visible management link between the board and district functions.
School and role labels are readable.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source, the rubric and the orgchart/tree exemplar, without seeing the engine's own output.

review.evidence: The board connects to the superintendent, who is the sole visible link to district functions. Each principal is visibly under the relevant school executive, and Teaching & Learning leads both academic roles. Labels are readable, with no material overlap or cropping.

items.evidence: Board of Education is positioned above and connected vertically to Dr Elena Park, Superintendent.
Sarah Dunn and Tom Nguyen are beneath Mark Ellis; Ken Wallace and Dana Holt are beneath Dr Aisha Bell.
Lila Stone, Director, Teaching & Learning, is connected above Ravi Mehta and Jo Grant.
The only visible path from the board to district functions runs through the superintendent.
School and role labels are legible, with no material overlap or cropping.
